_comment: ti375_oob — binds the SD host controller to the AXI slave declared in
config/linux/generic/sdhc.json describes what an mmc node looks like but
not which device it is; Efinix supply that binding from their -u/-e
override directories, which do not apply to this design. efx installs this
file into the generator's config/linux/<arch>/<board>/ directory instead,
where init.sh picks it up with no -u/-e flag.
Needs the ti375_oob RTL from branch stalya-fmu_v3.0-npu onwards, where the
hard SoC reaches gSDHC at 0xEB00_0000 and sd_int drives userInterruptF,
PLIC line 6. Earlier bitstreams give gSDHC to the soft FCU SoC. Enable
